applied_inputs.value: HP paid $11.0bn in cash for Autonomy (£25.50 a share, a 63.7% premium to the unaffected price) against FY2010 reported revenue of $870mm and IFRS net profit of $217mm. On Autonomy's own reported numbers, a DCF gives $13.75 a share with no growth at the case-date cost of capital (7.87%) and $26.43 with FY2010 growth fading to the 8% market growth HP cited, at the signing-date cost of capital (8.14%), against $42.11 paid; HP's 10-Q says Autonomy's fair value only approximated its carrying value at acquisition.
